title: [DEV] BG in AAPSClient differ from AAPS/NS by decimal (v1 API)
symptom: In AAPSClient 3.2.0-dev-l, the blood glucose value displayed differs from AAPS and Nightscout by a decimal when using the v1 API. The issue does not occur with the v3 API.
evidence_quote: Only applies to V1 API. in V3 BG is same in AAPS/AAPSClient and NS.
